purpose: Acceptance questions for the future chatbot. These are evaluation rubrics, not measured accuracy results. Keep this file out of the retrieval corpus.

questions.question: I received my admission letter. How do I enrol at DIT?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain Primuss confirmation, photo/document upload, payment and the individual admission-letter deadline.

questions.question: What documents does DIT generally ask for at enrolment?
questions.expected_behavior: List the source documents with applicable qualifications. Explain that the admission letter controls the individual list.

questions.question: Is there one enrolment deadline for every DIT programme?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that the deadline varies and is in the admission letter. Do not invent a universal date.

questions.question: Can DIT finish my enrolment without digital insurance confirmation?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the electronic confirmation requirement and the statutory insurer role.

questions.question: I have an EHIC from an EU country. What do I send to DIT?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain contacting a public insurer with the EHIC for assessment and electronic confirmation.

questions.question: I am newly enrolled and gave DIT a German postal address. How will I get my student card?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the mailing procedure and the approximate week before semester start stated in the snapshot.

questions.question: I gave DIT an address abroad. Where can I get my student card?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain collection at the Centre for Studies from semester start.

questions.question: Do I need to validate my student card every semester?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain validation at a terminal and the semester update.

questions.question: Where can I download my enrolment certificate?
questions.expected_behavior: Point to the Primuss study-certificates function. Distinguish next-semester enrolment certificate availability from re-registration confirmation.

questions.question: How do I activate my university account?
questions.expected_behavior: Use the emailed individual check-in link and matriculation number.

questions.question: Is my applicant number the same as my matriculation number?
questions.expected_behavior: State that they are different and point to the admission registration certificate for the matriculation number.

questions.question: Who can help me with DIT IT problems?
questions.expected_behavior: Provide the DIT IT support contact from the source. Keep the ECRI-specific support contact scoped to ECRI.

questions.question: I am a new non-EU degree student with no exemption. Which DIT fees should I expect?
questions.expected_behavior: Distinguish the EUR 60 application fee, EUR 500 semester service fee and separate semester-specific student-union fee. Ask which semester.

questions.question: Do EU students pay the international service fee?
questions.expected_behavior: Use the stated EU/EEA exemption. Do not claim exemption from the separate student-union contribution.

questions.question: When is re-registration for summer semester 2027?
questions.expected_behavior: Give 8 January to 5 February 2027, with the semester explicitly named.

questions.question: What is the student-union contribution for summer semester 2027?
questions.expected_behavior: Give EUR 87 for that semester. Explain that additional service fees may apply depending on status.

questions.question: What student-union contribution is listed from winter 2027/28?
questions.expected_behavior: Give EUR 92 and preserve the stated semester applicability.

questions.question: I missed the re-registration period. What should I do?
questions.expected_behavior: Direct the student to their responsible Centre for Studies clerk. Do not promise automatic reinstatement.

questions.question: Can I apply for Studierendenwerk housing before receiving admission?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that an application before admission is possible and does not itself create a rental contract.

questions.question: Is there a fixed annual deadline to apply for a dorm?
questions.expected_behavior: For these Studierendenwerk residences, applications can be made at any time.

questions.question: How do I keep my housing application active?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the monthly reminder on the 20th and confirmation within seven days.

questions.question: Can I edit a confirmed Studierendenwerk housing application myself?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that housing staff must make the change and direct the student to the relevant contact.

questions.question: Can I collect my room keys on Sunday?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the normal restriction on weekend and public-holiday handovers and refer to the caretaker for arrangements.

questions.question: Can I move into my dorm before the contract begins?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the first-working-day handover rule and the previous tenant’s right to occupy the room.

questions.question: What is the address of Finkenhof Detterstrasse?
questions.expected_behavior: Give Detterstrasse 21, 94469 Deggendorf.

questions.question: Does the Untere Himmelreichstrasse residence have a private kitchen and bathroom?
questions.expected_behavior: Answer from the accommodation description. Do not infer current vacancy.

questions.question: Which Studierendenwerk residences are listed in Deggendorf?
questions.expected_behavior: List Bahnhofstrasse, Detterstrasse, Frauenstrasse and Untere Himmelreichstrasse.

questions.question: I am an exchange student interested in Untere Himmelreichstrasse. How should I apply?
questions.expected_behavior: Use the specifically labelled International Office route for exchange students.

questions.question: Is my rental contract alone the landlord confirmation?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain the housing-provider move-in confirmation requirement. Link to the official city form page.

questions.question: I have just moved into a flat in Deggendorf. When should I register?
questions.expected_behavior: Give the ordinary two-week deadline from moving in. Preserve special temporary-stay exceptions if relevant.

questions.question: Are address registration and a student residence permit the same process?
questions.expected_behavior: Distinguish the Bürgeramt address process from the immigration-authority permit process.

questions.question: Which documents does Deggendorf ask for for a student residence permit?
questions.expected_behavior: Use the local checklist, including enrolment and study-time certificates, funds, passport, housing and insurance. Cite the original authority URL.

questions.question: Does the residence-permit photo need a QR code?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that the German checklist specifies a QR code and that this point is a labelled translation in the collection.

questions.question: My study visa expires soon. Can I wait three months after arrival to apply for the permit?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that the application must be submitted before the visa expires. Direct the student to the local authority.

questions.question: What do banks usually ask for to open an account?
questions.expected_behavior: List the general documents and qualify bank/account-specific requirements and fees.

questions.question: We share a flat. Does every student pay the broadcasting contribution separately?
questions.expected_behavior: Apply the shared-dwelling rule and explain the role of the paying resident’s contribution number.

questions.question: Does being a student automatically exempt me from the broadcasting contribution?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that student status alone does not create an exemption; use the stated eligibility rules.

questions.question: Can I work while studying as a non-EU student?
questions.expected_behavior: Give qualified guidance from the source, preserve the day-account or permitted weekly approach and ask about residence conditions and job type where needed.

questions.question: Hi! I am new here.
questions.expected_behavior: Greet the student warmly and ask what they need help with. No source citation or retrieval-based refusal is required.

questions.question: Which dorm has an empty room available today?
questions.expected_behavior: Explain that the static collection does not establish live availability and direct the student to the housing provider/application portal. Do not invent a vacancy.
